###alb
```{r}
#combining all dstatistics and metadata for Q. alb
library(dplyr)
library(plyr)
library(readxl)
meta_pop<-read.delim("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_DSuite_MACREF/Pops.txt")
Dalb_All<-data.frame(pop=character(),chr=character(),windowStart=integer(),windowEnd=integer(),D=double(),f_d=double(),f_dM=double(),d_f=double(),lat=double(),long=double(),windowmid=integer())

for(i in 1:length(meta_pop$Pop)){
  pop<-meta_pop$Pop[i]
  lat<-meta_pop$latitude.orig[i]
  long<-meta_pop$longitude.orig[i]
  if(file.exists(paste("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_Dsuite_MACREF/DPOPS/bic_mac_",pop,"_alb_localFstats__1000_750.txt",sep=""))){
    Dalb_pop<-subset(read.delim(paste("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_Dsuite_MACREF/DPOPS/bic_mac_",pop,"_alb_localFstats__1000_750.txt",sep="")),chr=="Chr01"|chr=="Chr02"|chr=="Chr03"|chr=="Chr04"|chr=="Chr05"|chr=="Chr06"|chr=="Chr07"|chr=="Chr08"|chr=="Chr09"|chr=="Chr10"|chr=="Chr11"|chr=="Chr12")
    Dalb_pop$pop<-rep(pop,length(Dalb_pop$chr))
    Dalb_pop$lat<-rep(lat,length(Dalb_pop$chr))
    Dalb_pop$long<-rep(long,length(Dalb_pop$chr))
    Dalb_pop$windowmid<-round_any(rowMeans(Dalb_pop[,2:3]),500000)
    Dalb_All<-rbind(Dalb_All,Dalb_pop)
  }
  #Dalb_pop$Loc<-paste(Dalb_pop$CHROM,Dalb_pop$BIN_START,sep="_")
  
}
Dalb_All$chr2<-Dalb_All$chr
Dalb_All<-Dalb_All %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across('chr2',str_replace,'Chr',''))
Dalb_All$chr3<-as.numeric(Dalb_All$chr2)

write.table(Dalb_All,file="C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_Dsuite_MACREF/DPOPS/bic_mac_alb.txt",row.names=FALSE,quote=FALSE,sep="\t")
#I don't know that window number is the best method

```

```{r}
##for 500,000 bp windows, saiving the max d_f for each population (this helps with visualizing)

Dsp_All<-data.frame(pop=character(),chr=character(),windowStart=integer(),windowEnd=integer(),D=double(),f_d=double(),f_dM=double(),d_f=double(),lat=double(),long=double(),windowmid=integer(),species=character(),chr2=character(),chr3=integer())
for(j in 1:12){
  i=min(D_All$windowmid)
  while(i <= max(D_All$windowmid)){
    if(i %in% subset(Dbi_All,chr3==j)$windowmid){
      Dwind<-rbind(subset(Dalb_All,windowmid==i&chr3==j),subset(Dbi_All,windowmid==i&chr3==j),subset(Dlob_All,windowmid==i&chr3==j),subset(Dly_All,windowmid==i&chr3==j),subset(Dmue_All,windowmid==i&chr3==j),subset(Dste_All,windowmid==i&chr3==j))
      Dsp_All<-rbind(Dsp_All,(Dwind %>% group_by(pop) %>% top_n(1, d_f)))
    }
    i=i+500000
  }
}

write.table(Dsp_All,file="C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_Dsuite_MACREF/DPOPS/DspMax5E5_mac.txt",row.names=FALSE,quote=FALSE,sep="\t")
```

###Calculating DMSE for 150,000 bp windows
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)

D_All<-read.delim("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_Dsuite_MACREF/DPOPS/Dall_mac.txt",header = TRUE)

DWindMSE<-data.frame(chr=integer(),window=integer(),alb=double(),bic=double(),lob=double(),lyr=double(),mue=double(),ste=double())

for(j in 1:12){
  i=75000
  while(i <= max(subset(D_All,chr==paste("Chr",j,sep=""))$windowMid)){
    DallWind<-subset(D_All,windowMid>i-75000&windowMid<i+75000&chr==paste("Chr",j,sep="")) %>% group_by(pop,species) %>% top_n(1, d_f)
    if(length(subset(DallWind,species=="alb")$d_f)>8|length(subset(DallWind,species=="bic")$d_f)>8|length(subset(DallWind,species=="lob")$d_f)>8|length(subset(DallWind,species=="mue")$d_f)>8|length(subset(DallWind,species=="mue")$d_f)>8){
      if(length(subset(DallWind,species=="alb")$d_f)>8){
        MSEalb<- mean(summary(lm(data=subset(DallWind,species=="alb"),d_f~windowMid))$residuals^2)
      }else{MSEalb<-NA}
      if(length(subset(DallWind,species=="bic")$d_f)>8){
        MSEbic<- mean(summary(lm(data=subset(DallWind,species=="bic"),d_f~windowMid))$residuals^2)
        MSElyr<- mean(summary(lm(data=subset(DallWind,species=="lyr"),d_f~windowMid))$residuals^2)
      }else{
        MSEbic<-NA
        MSElyr<-NA
      }
      if(length(subset(DallWind,species=="lob")$d_f)>8){
        MSElob<- mean(summary(lm(data=subset(DallWind,species=="lob"),d_f~windowMid))$residuals^2)
      }else{MSElob<-NA}
      if(length(subset(DallWind,species=="mue")$d_f)>8){
        MSEmue<- mean(summary(lm(data=subset(DallWind,species=="mue"),d_f~windowMid))$residuals^2)
      }else{MSEmue<-NA}
      if(length(subset(DallWind,species=="ste")$d_f)>8){
        MSEste<- mean(summary(lm(data=subset(DallWind,species=="ste"),d_f~windowMid))$residuals^2)
      }else{MSEste<-NA}
      MSE<-data.frame(chr=j,window=i,alb=MSEalb,bic=MSEbic,lob=MSElob,lyr=MSElyr,mue=MSEmue,ste=MSEste)
      DWindMSE<-rbind(DWindMSE,MSE)
    }
    i=i+75000
  }
}


write.table(DWindMSE,file="C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_Dsuite_MACREF/DPOPS/Dmse_all_mac.txt",row.names=FALSE,quote=FALSE,sep="\t")
```

###Calculate windows of high DMSE
```{r}
DMSE_All<-read.delim("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_Dsuite_MACREF/DPOPS/Dmse_all_mac.txt",header = TRUE)
DMSE99<-quantile(c(DMSE_All$alb,DMSE_All$bic,DMSE_All$lob,DMSE_All$lyr,DMSE_All$mue,DMSE_All$ste),probs=c(0.99),na.rm=TRUE)

#DMSE_highpoints<-subset(DMSE_All,alb>=DMSE99|bic>=DMSE99|lob>=DMSE99|lyr>=DMSE99|mue>=DMSE99|ste>=DMSE99)

DMSE_highregions<-data.frame(chr=integer(),window=integer(),alb=double(),bic=double(),lob=double(),lyr=double(),mue=double(),ste=double(),windowstart=integer(),windowend=integer(),species=character())
for(j in 1:12){
  i<-1
  while(i < length(DMSE_All$window)){
    if(max(DMSE_All[i,j])>=DMSE99&!is.na(DMSE_All[i,j])){
      DMSE_highregions<-rbind(DMSE_highregions, cbind(DMSE_All[i,],windowstart=DMSE_All[i,2]-75000,windowend=DMSE_All[i,2]+75000,species=names(DMSE_All)[j]))
      #i=i+1
      k=0
      
      while(max(DMSE_All[i,j])>=DMSE99|is.na(DMSE_All[i,j])|k<3){
        i=i+1
        if(max(DMSE_All[i,j])>=DMSE99&!is.na(DMSE_All[i,j])){
          DMSE_highregions$windowend[length(DMSE_highregions$windowend)]<-DMSE_All[i,2]+75000
        }else{k=k+1}
      }
    }else{
      i=i+1
    }
  }
  
}
write.table(DMSE_highregions,"C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_Dsuite_MACREF/DPOPS/DMSE_High_mac.txt",row.names=FALSE,quote=FALSE,sep="\t")
```

```{r}
  i=min(subset(D_All,chr==paste("Chr",j,sep=""))$windowmid)
  while(i <= max(subset(D_All,chr==paste("Chr",j,sep=""))$windowmid)){
    ggplot(data=subset(D_All,windowStart>i-500000&windowStart<i+500000))+
      
     # coord_cartesian(ylim(0.25,1),expand=FALSE)+
      xlim(i-500000,i+500000)+
      scale_color_manual(values=group.colors)+
      facet_grid(species~.)+
      geom_point(aes(x=windowStart,y=d_f,alpha=lat,group=pop,color=species),size=1)+
      #geom_line(aes(x=windowStart,y=d_f,color=species,group=pop))+
      theme_light()
    p+
      geom_point(aes(x=windowStart,y=d_f,fill=lat,group=pop),size=1,shape=21)+
      scale_color_viridis_b()
    i=i+500000
  }
  
}
```
